Name: FULL AUTO ASSIST 1.3.0
Description: Full Auto Assist v1.3.0 simulates automatic firing for 31 supported weapons. Configure individual weapons, firing profiles, and cadences directly through the in-game Mod Options Menu. All weapons default to enabled with Balanced behavior where applicable. Repeats normal Fire input without modifying weapon statistics.

Options.Name: Full Auto Assist
Options.Description: Core runtime with the unified in-game per-weapon settings integration and all existing firing profiles.
